evals.name: plan-shown-in-chat-before-approval
evals.prompt: Analyze how the authentication flow works in this codebase. No .claude/workflows/analyze.js exists in the project yet.
evals.expected_output: Frames an analysis plan, displays it inline in the chat, and asks for approval before launching anything.
expectations: Created .start/analysis/<NNN>-<name>/analysis.md with frontmatter containing name, description, a goals list, and status: draft
Displayed the full plan inline in the chat before asking for approval — the purpose (description), the goals as a numbered rubric, and the proposed research topics — not merely a path to the file
Asked the user to approve or refine the plan before launching (interactive gate)
Phrased each goal as a checkable objective a validator can rule met or unmet by evidence
Did NOT begin research, spawn research agents, or write any report itself before approval

evals.name: seed-install-launch-on-approval
evals.prompt: Analyze the caching strategy across the services and how it invalidates. No installed analyze workflow exists yet. Assume I approve the plan you propose.
evals.expected_output: On approval, seeds research tasks, installs the bundled workflow, and launches analyze.js on the dynamic-workflow runtime.
expectations: Seeded one research task per approved topic via task.js create --home .start/analysis/<...> --type research, recording the returned ids
Detected no installed .claude/workflows/analyze.js and copied the bundled reference/analyze.js into the project, reporting the installed version
Launched the Workflow tool with scriptPath pointing at .claude/workflows/analyze.js and args containing name, home, taskScript, description, goals, topics, reportPath, and maxRounds
Passed the approved goals rubric and the seeded topic ids into the workflow args
Did NOT perform the research, validation, or synthesis itself — delegated all of it to the workflow

evals.name: workflow-version-upgrade-prompt
evals.prompt: Analyze the error-handling patterns in the payment service. An older .claude/workflows/analyze.js is already installed with version marker v1; the bundled reference is v2. Assume I approve the plan.
evals.expected_output: Detects the version mismatch and prompts to upgrade before launching; never clobbers the installed copy silently.
expectations: Compared the installed version marker (v1) against the bundled reference (v2)
Asked the user via AskUserQuestion whether to upgrade v1 -> v2, with Upgrade recommended and Keep current as the alternative
Did not overwrite the installed .claude/workflows/analyze.js without the user's Upgrade choice
Proceeded to build args and launch the workflow after resolving the version

evals.name: refine-goals-then-redisplay
evals.prompt: Analyze the database access layer. When you show me the plan, add a goal about detecting N+1 query patterns, then proceed.
evals.expected_output: Shows the plan, incorporates the refinement into the frontmatter, re-displays the updated plan, and only then proceeds.
expectations: Displayed the initial plan (purpose, goals, topics) in the chat
On the refine request, edited analysis.md frontmatter to add the N+1 detection goal and re-displayed the updated plan in the chat
Preserved the other goals when adding the new one
Did not launch the workflow until the refined plan was settled
Set status to approved (or equivalent) only after the plan was finalized
